meta_description: AHL Electrical in Hull delivers reliable domestic and commercial electrical work. Fast, certified, and honest. Call 07875 080098 for a free quote.
hero_subhead: From rewires to emergency call-outs, we fix faults fast and keep your home safe.
services_subhead: We handle everything from emergency repairs and fault-finding to complete rewires and installations.

services.title: Emergency Callouts
services.desc: Blown circuits, no power, or burning smells — we respond fast, any time of day or night. Most faults fixed on the spot.

services.title: Fault-Finding & Repairs
services.desc: Flickering lights, faulty sockets, or tripped switches? We diagnose the problem quickly and repair it right first time.

services.title: Full Rewires
services.desc: Bring old wiring up to modern safety standards with a full house rewire. Improves safety, adds outlets, and future-proofs your home.

services.title: Boiler & Heating Electrics
services.desc: Installation and repair of electric heating systems, immersion heaters, and related electrical work for your heating.

services.title: Commercial & Industrial
services.desc: Reliable electrical maintenance, upgrades, and new installations for shops, offices, and light industrial premises.

services.title: Testing & Certification
services.desc: EICR (Electrical Installation Condition Report) and periodic testing to meet your legal safety obligations.

about_pullquote: I started this firm because I got fed up with cowboys charging over the odds.
about_para_1: AHL Electrical has been serving Hull for over two decades. Born and bred locally, we've built our reputation on straightforward honest work — no surprises, no inflated bills, just reliable electrical expertise.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we turn up on time, explain what we're doing, and charge a fair price. Whether it's a midnight emergency or a planned rewire, you'll get the same professional standard every time.
reviews_heading: What Hull Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Called AHL on a Sunday morning with no power in half the house. Lee arrived within an hour, found a loose connection in the consumer unit, and had us back up and running by lunch. Couldn't ask for better service, and the price was more than fair.
reviews.author: Michael P.

reviews.text: We needed our old bungalow rewired before selling. AHL did the whole job in a week with minimal fuss. Neat work, tidy site, proper certification. Very pleased and would definitely recommend them.
reviews.author: Sandra T.

reviews.text: Emergency call to fix our immersion heater switch — they turned up same evening, diagnosed it straight away, and had it working again. Professional bloke, honest pricing. Will use them again for sure.
reviews.author: David M.
